data_objects.name: subject_physiological_environmental_samples
data_objects.meaning: Row-level physiological, ambient-environment, and particle sensor readings organized by subject and a subject-local relative index.

variables.name: Skin Resistance
variables.meaning: Skin-resistance sensor reading associated with the subject sample.

variables.name: Light
variables.meaning: Ambient-light sensor reading aligned to the subject sample.

variables.name: Nr.particles0.3
variables.meaning: Numeric particle-count reading for the particle channel labelled 0.3.

variables.name: Nr.particles0.5
variables.meaning: Numeric particle-count reading for the particle channel labelled 0.5.

variables.name: Nr.particles1.0
variables.meaning: Numeric particle-count reading for the particle channel labelled 1.0.

variables.name: Temperature
variables.meaning: Ambient-temperature sensor reading aligned to the subject sample.

variables.name: Humidity
variables.meaning: Ambient-humidity sensor reading aligned to the subject sample.

variables.name: Pressure
variables.meaning: Ambient-pressure sensor reading aligned to the subject sample.

variables.name: IAQ
variables.meaning: Environmental sensor reading labelled IAQ; its expansion and scale are not defined in the public artifact.

variables.name: Sound
variables.meaning: Sound-sensor reading aligned to the subject sample.

variables.name: Heart Rate
variables.meaning: Heart-rate sensor reading associated with the subject sample.

variables.name: Subject
variables.meaning: Categorical numeric identifier for a subject; observed identifiers are 1 through 14.

variables.name: Relative_Index
variables.meaning: Zero-based sequence index local to each subject; it resets to 0 and increments by 1 within every observed subject block.

structure.description: The CSV contains 33,993 data rows and 13 columns. Each row aligns 11 numeric sensor channels to one Subject and one Relative_Index. Subject and Relative_Index together form an observed unique record key. Rows are stored as one contiguous block per subject in ascending Subject order (1 through 14), and Relative_Index is contiguous from 0 through the subject-specific final index; subject blocks therefore have unequal lengths. The table has no separate session identifier or absolute timestamp.

uncertainties: The public artifact supplies no units for any measurement channel. Values are consistent with several customary sensor units, but those units are not established by the file and are therefore left null.
Relative_Index is demonstrably a subject-local sequence counter, but no sampling interval, frequency, timezone, elapsed-time unit, or mapping to absolute time is provided.
The particle labels 0.3, 0.5, and 1.0 do not state a size unit, whether they denote bins or thresholds, or the counting volume or interval.
The scales and device-level definitions of Skin Resistance, Light, IAQ, Sound, and the other sensor channels are not documented in the public artifact.
Row co-occurrence establishes tabular alignment among channels but does not establish their original sensor update rates or physical synchronization.
No blank cells or common textual missing tokens (NA, NaN, null, or NULL) were observed; undocumented numeric sentinel values cannot be ruled out.
annotation_notes: Evidence was limited to the declared public CSV and the treatment instructions for general semantic inspection and physiological/environmental sensing.

Inspection covered the header, file endpoints, the first record of each subject, and full-file structural checks for field counts, subject-index continuity, duplicate composite keys, subject block ordering, and common textual missing encodings.
